description.en: Indicates whether the SQL is a template SQL.
The ID of the formatted SQL statement.

description.zh:
- 当值为 True 时，查询 SQLID 在数据库中的限流信息。  
- 当值为 False 时，查询 SQLID 在数据库中绑定索引或是绑定执行计划信息。
description.en:
- Set to `true` to query the throttling information.

- Set to `false` to query the bound index or bound execution plan.

description.zh:
租户名称。
长度为 2~20 个字符，支持英文字母、数字和下划线，区分大小写，必须以字母或下划线开头，不可设置为 sys。
description.en: The tenant name. Note: Although this parameter is named TableName, it specifies the tenant name. The name must be 2–20 characters long, consist of letters, digits, and underscores (\_), be case-sensitive, start with a letter or an underscore, and not be the reserved word sys.

title.zh: 查询 Outline 绑定信息

example.unifiedCli: aliyun oceanbasepro describe-outline-binding --tenant-id t2mr3oae00000 --table-name pay_online --database-name testdb --sql-id 8D6E8400000B8FB1823D199E2CA10000 --is-concurrent-limit false --instance-id ob317v4uif0000 --dynamic-sql true --format-sql-id example-string --region cn-hangzhou
